description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is a pivotal leadership opportunity for a compassionate and results-oriented nursing professional to ensure the highest standards of patient care and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate will oversee all nursing operations, manage staff, and maintain regulatory compliance, contributing significantly to the well-being of our residents. We are actively looking to fill this vital role by June 30th and offer a competitive salary package for the right individual.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a Director of Nursing or in a similar nursing leadership role
Proven experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations for long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.
